facts.fact: The guild keeps a watcher in the pass village who logs each night which shapes are abroad on the hill; a night with no shape out on an open contract reads as refusal and is reported to Chathu.
facts.why: needed because the outline's 'guild's watcher logged both' requires a mechanism for the missed signal.

facts.fact: Chathu sends the carrier a balance sheet for every open contract; Ammu copied one entry from the carrier's satchel: 'Balance due from the Keeper on the widow's seal.'
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a stolen slip from Chathu's accounts.

facts.fact: Chapter 22 is the second consecutive night Neela skips resin (the rain night of ch 21 was the first) and seven nights remain to the new moon.
facts.why: needed to track the ache count and Chathu's new-moon deadline.

facts.fact: Devan has a puckered white seam at the ribs from the raider captain's knife at the ford, before the captain knelt.
facts.why: small body detail for the intimate scene.
